lines.en: Thank you. Could you note that no spray should be used in the new room?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Yes, I'll leave an allergy note in the system.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That would really put my mind at ease.

hotel-b2x-invoicecompany.title: Requesting a company invoice instead of personal receipt

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: When I check out, could the receipt be issued to my company instead?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Yes, that's possible. Could you give me the company name and business registration number?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: One moment, let me find my business card.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Here, please use this information.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Got it. Should the portion paid on your personal card also be listed under the company?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: No, that was personal spending, so please keep it separate.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Understood, I'll issue two separate receipts.

hotel-b2x-elevatoroutage.title: Elevator out of service during stay

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: The sign says the elevator is out of order — I'm on the 15th floor, what should I do?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: We're sorry for the inconvenience. The elevator on the other side is running normally.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Oh, I didn't know that. Which way should I go?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: It's at the end of the hallway on the far side of the lobby — shall I show you?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, I have luggage too, so some help would be great.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Sure, I'll personally guide you there.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you — about when will it be fixed?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: I've heard the repair should be finished by evening.

hotel-b2x-currencyrate.title: Questioning the currency exchange rate applied

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Looking at the statement, a higher exchange rate was applied than what I knew.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: We offer our own currency conversion service instead of going through the card company.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: So was that applied automatically? I never chose that option.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: There should have been notice in the form you signed at check-in — let me check.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, please check. If I didn't want it, can it be canceled?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: We can reprocess it using the original payment method.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I'd appreciate that, thank you.

hotel-b2x-wrongroomassigned.title: Two guests accidentally assigned the same room

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I went into my room, and someone else's luggage is already there!

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: I'm so sorry! Let me check right away.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: It seems a system error on our end assigned the same room to two guests.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Then can you move me to a different room right away?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Yes, we'll move you to an upgraded room, and offer complimentary breakfast for the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you. But my luggage is already in that room — what do we do about that?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Our staff will move it to the new room for you.

hotel-b2x-petpolicy.title: Clarifying the pet policy after booking

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I didn't realize this when booking, but we brought our dog. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Our hotel allows pets, but only small dogs.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That's a relief — our dog is about 5 kilograms.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: That should be fine. There is an additional cleaning fee, though.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: How much is it?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: It's 30,000 won per night, charged together at checkout.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Understood, that's reasonable.

hotel-b2x-latecheckoutfee.title: Negotiating a waived late checkout fee

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I'd like to keep the room until 2 p.m. — how much extra would that cost?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: After noon, half of one night's rate is added.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That's a bit steep. Since I've stayed three nights this time, could there be some adjustment?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Since you're a longer-staying guest, let me ask the manager.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you, I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: I checked, and they said we can extend it to noon for free.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That's plenty, thank you.

hotel-b2x-lastminuteupgrade.title: Bidding on a last-minute suite upgrade

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Would you be interested in upgrading to a suite? There's a special rate just for today.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Oh, how much more would that be?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: It's just 40,000 won extra, half the usual price difference.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That's not bad. What's different about the suite?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: It has a separate living area, and it includes a lounge access pass.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Sounds great, I'll take it.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Good choice — I'll remake your key right away.

hotel-b2x-loyaltypointsdispute.title: マイルプログラムの改悪

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: It looks like I didn't get points credited from my stay last month.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Could I have your membership number? I'll check.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Sure, here it is. I'll give you the reservation number too.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: I checked, and that booking came through a partner site, so it wasn't eligible for points.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I was never told that when I made the booking.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: You're right, our explanation was lacking. I'll consult the manager and manually credit the points for you.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you, I'd appreciate that.

hotel-b2x-medicalassistance.title: Guest feeling unwell asks for medical help

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Sorry to bother you, but I'm not feeling well — is there a pharmacy or clinic nearby?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Are you okay? What are your symptoms?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I have a slight fever and a headache.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: In that case, we can offer some basic emergency medicine, and guide you to a clinic if needed.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I'd like the medicine first.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Okay, I'll bring you a fever reducer. Please let us know right away if you don't feel better.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you. I feel better knowing you're helping.

hotel-b2x-earlymorningdeparture.title: Very early flight, needs breakfast box and quiet exit

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I have a 5 a.m. flight tomorrow, so I won't make it to breakfast hours.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: In that case, we can prepare a boxed breakfast for you in advance.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That sounds great — what time should I pick it up?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: We'll hand it to you at the front desk right when you check out.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: And the lobby should be quiet at that hour, right? My suitcase wheels are a bit noisy.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Yes, it's quiet in the early morning, so you don't need to worry.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you — I'll come down around 4:30 then.

hotel-b2x-conferenceequipment.title: Business guest needs extra equipment for a call

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I need to have a video call in the room, but the internet is too slow.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: I'm sorry — switching to a wired connection should be faster.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Then could I also borrow an ethernet cable?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Yes, I'll bring one right away. Do you also need a monitor or a stand?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: The monitor's fine, but the lighting seems a bit dim.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Shall I bring an extra desk lamp?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, that would really help.

phone-c1y-severance.title: Negotiating a severance package with HR

lines.speaker: 인사팀
lines.en: Hello, this is Seo-yeon Park from HR. I'm calling about the severance terms I emailed yesterday.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Yes, I saw it. But I'm not quite convinced by how the payout was calculated—it seems to only factor in tenure.

lines.speaker: 인사팀
lines.en: We can look into that point again on our end. That said, it's difficult to go beyond the multiplier tied to your grade level under company policy.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Could you at least include an outplacement support program then? The notice was so sudden I haven't had time to prepare.

lines.speaker: 인사팀
lines.en: That's a fair point. I'll propose adding a three-month reemployment support course to management.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Thank you. Also, I'd like the health insurance continuation period specified—it's missing from the current document.

lines.speaker: 인사팀
lines.en: You're right, it was left out. Per policy it's covered by the company for two months—I'll make sure it's clearly stated in the revised document.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Okay, I'll review and sign once I get the revised version. Please send it as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 인사팀
lines.en: Sure, I'll follow up by tomorrow morning. Thank you for working with us on this.

phone-c1y-whistleblower.title: A journalist interviews a whistleblower by phone

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling to ask a few more questions about the tip you gave us last time.

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: Sure, but I'll only answer on the condition that my identity stays hidden. It'll be a problem if the company catches on.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Of course. We're strict about keeping sources anonymous. So when do you think the accounting manipulation began?

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: As far as I know, it started in the fourth quarter of last year, and there are signs they created fabricated transactions to inflate revenue.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Do you have concrete evidence in hand? To report this, we need something to substantiate it.

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: I have some internal emails and approval documents, but I'm worried about how to hand them over safely.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: If you send them through an encrypted channel, we'll handle it according to our source-protection protocol.

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: Understood. But once this is published, there's a chance the company could still identify me, so please proceed carefully.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: I fully understand. We'll also give you a chance to review the draft before it's published.

phone-c1y-shared-wall.title: Mediating a dispute between neighbors over a shared wall

lines.speaker: 관리소장
lines.en: Hello, this is the building manager. I'm calling because you requested to discuss the wall issue with your neighbor.

lines.speaker: 주민
lines.en: Yes, the neighbor is saying our shared wall cracked and wants us to split the repair cost, but I don't think the cause is on our side.

lines.speaker: 관리소장
lines.en: I think the first step is pinpointing the exact cause of the crack. How about getting a structural engineer's assessment?

lines.speaker: 주민
lines.en: If we do that, who covers the cost? Since the cause isn't even clear, I'm reluctant to pay for the assessment upfront.

lines.speaker: 관리소장
lines.en: Conventionally, the assessment cost is split evenly, and the repair-cost ratio is decided based on the findings—that's the reasonable approach.

lines.speaker: 주민
lines.en: I'm not sure the neighbor will agree to that approach. They've already concluded it's our fault.

lines.speaker: 관리소장
lines.en: As the mediator, I'll try to persuade both sides. This needs to be resolved with objective evidence before it turns emotional.

lines.speaker: 주민
lines.en: Yes, I'd appreciate that. We don't think our position is an unreasonable ask.

lines.speaker: 관리소장
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange an inspection company within the week and let both sides know the schedule.

phone-c1y-lawyer-client.title: A lawyer explains contract terms to a worried client

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling to go over the contract review results. I know you've been worried about this.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: Yes, especially the penalty clause—it seemed way too steep, so I wanted to check with you before signing.

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: As you said, the penalty for terminating the contract is set at three times the down payment, which is considerably higher than industry norms.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: So can I request that this clause be adjusted? I'm not sure the other party will readily accept it though.

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: There's plenty of room for negotiation. Rather than pushing too hard, though, I'd suggest proposing a compromise that caps the penalty amount.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: Understood. Also, the automatic renewal clause was written pretty vaguely—could that be an issue too?

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: Yes, since there's no specified deadline for termination notice, you could end up locked in longer than you want. This needs to be revised as well.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: There's more to fix than I expected. When can I get the revision request document?

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: I'll draft it up and send it by email today. Let's hold off on signing until after that.

phone-c1y-parent-care.title: Discussing end-of-life care arrangements with a parent

lines.speaker: 딸
lines.en: Mom, I'm calling again about the care facility the hospital mentioned last time. I wanted to talk it through in more detail.

lines.speaker: 어머니
lines.en: Sure, but honestly, I really want to stay at home. I'm not mentally ready to go into a facility yet.

lines.speaker: 딸
lines.en: I understand how you feel. But given that we can't check in often these days, what about having an in-home caregiver instead?

lines.speaker: 어머니
lines.en: A caregiver... having a stranger come in and out of the house feels burdensome, but it might be better than a facility.

lines.speaker: 딸
lines.en: From what I looked into, there's also an option to combine home nursing visits with a day-care center. Some of the cost can be subsidized too.

lines.speaker: 어머니
lines.en: That sounds a bit more appealing. But what did the medical staff say? They mentioned it might be too much to live alone.

lines.speaker: 딸
lines.en: Right, the attending doctor also said you need care at least during daytime hours. That's why I'm suggesting this as a middle ground.

lines.speaker: 어머니
lines.en: All right. Let's start with a home-nursing consultation before deciding. I don't want to rush into a conclusion.

lines.speaker: 딸
lines.en: Of course, let's take our time. I'll book a consultation appointment for next week and go with you.

lines.speaker: 어머니
lines.en: Thank you, sweetheart. It's a relief that you're asking me instead of deciding on your own.

phone-c1y-investor-pitch.title: A startup founder pitches an investor over the phone

lines.speaker: 창업자
lines.en: Hello, I'm the founder who was introduced to you last week. Thank you for showing interest in our service.

lines.speaker: 투자자
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I skimmed the materials, and it looks like you're putting more weight on user growth than revenue. Is there a reason for that?

lines.speaker: 창업자
lines.en: Yes, we judged that creating a lock-in effect was the priority at this early stage. We plan to fully roll out monetization starting Q3.

lines.speaker: 투자자
lines.en: I see. But competitors seem to be using a similar strategy, so I'm curious what your differentiator is from our perspective.

lines.speaker: 창업자
lines.en: We have an edge in the accuracy of our data-driven recommendation algorithm, and our return-visit rate is actually more than double the industry average.

lines.speaker: 투자자
lines.en: Those numbers are impressive. Still, this round's valuation seems set a bit high—can you explain the rationale further?

lines.speaker: 창업자
lines.en: It reflects our growth rate and market size, but there's room for adjustment. I'd like to discuss the specifics during due diligence.

lines.speaker: 투자자
lines.en: Good. Let's schedule a meeting with the due-diligence team next week and go over the financial data in detail.

lines.speaker: 창업자
lines.en: Sure, I'll prepare and send the necessary materials in advance. I hope this leads to a good outcome.

phone-c1y-union-negotiation.title: A union rep negotiates with management

lines.speaker: 노조 대표
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling to hear management's position first regarding this round of wage negotiations.

lines.speaker: 인사담당
lines.en: Yes, on our end we're considering a 3 percent raise reflecting inflation. That's some distance from the union's proposal, I know.

lines.speaker: 노조 대표
lines.en: We proposed 5 percent. At 3 percent, real wages would actually fall, so it's hard for our members to accept.

lines.speaker: 인사담당
lines.en: I hope you can understand the company's situation too. Performance this year has been lower than expected, so the labor-cost burden is significant.

lines.speaker: 노조 대표
lines.en: I understand that part, but you'll need to provide alternatives—like performance bonuses or expanded benefit points—for me to persuade our members.

lines.speaker: 인사담당
lines.en: That's a reasonable proposal. We'll consider adjusting the base pay increase to 4 percent and raising the benefit points.

lines.speaker: 노조 대표
lines.en: Thank you for considering it positively. But this is only a tentative proposal, so I'll follow up after it goes through the union general meeting.

lines.speaker: 인사담당
lines.en: Sure, please let us know once the meeting date is set. We'll prepare and engage in good faith as well.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Hello, this is the credit bureau. I'm calling regarding the dispute you filed about your credit rating.

lines.speaker: 고객
lines.en: Yes, a loan I fully paid off years ago is still showing up as a delinquency and it's affecting my rating.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Looking into it, it seems the financial institution reported the payoff late. Do you have the relevant documents?

lines.speaker: 고객
lines.en: Yes, I have the payoff certificate. Where should I submit it for the correction to be processed quickly?

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: If you attach a scanned copy through our online complaint portal, the correction will be processed within five business days.

lines.speaker: 고객
lines.en: But because of this error, my recent loan application was rejected. Is retroactive compensation for the damage possible?

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Direct monetary compensation isn't within our authority, but we can issue a correction confirmation you can use as supporting material when reapplying.

lines.speaker: 고객
lines.en: Understood. Please process the correction quickly first, and include the confirmation document as well.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Sure, once you submit it, we'll notify you by text as soon as it's processed. We apologize for the inconvenience.

phone-c1y-therapy-intake.title: A therapist conducts an intake call

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling to do a brief pre-intake interview before your counseling appointment. Feel free to answer at your own pace.

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: Sure, honestly I've been sleeping poorly and can't focus at work lately, which is why I signed up for counseling.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: How long has this state persisted? I'm also curious if there was a specific trigger.

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: It's been about two months, and ever since a big project at work failed, I keep blaming myself over and over.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Could you tell me a bit more specifically how that experience has shaped how you evaluate yourself?

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: I keep feeling incompetent, and I'm embarrassed to face my colleagues, so lately I've been avoiding people altogether.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: That must have been really hard. In the first session, we'll take time together to explore where these feelings are coming from.

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: Okay, thank you. But the content of our sessions is strictly confidential, right?

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Yes, except for a very few legally mandated exceptions, it's never disclosed externally, so you can rest assured.

phone-c2y-pollster-election.title: A radio call-in discusses a controversial local election result

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we're joined by phone with a polling expert to discuss the results of the recent local election. Hello.

lines.speaker: 전문가
lines.en: Hello, glad to be here. This election stands out as a case where the gap between pre-election polls and actual results was unusually large.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: How do you analyze the cause of that gap? Some have pointed to sample design issues.

lines.speaker: 전문가
lines.en: Sample issues played a role, but this time I think a failure to predict turnout was more decisive than the so-called shy conservative effect.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, this is a listener. But how did the higher-than-expected turnout among younger voters affect the outcome?

lines.speaker: 전문가
lines.en: Good question. Younger voters mobilized through social media, and that wasn't sufficiently captured in the existing polling samples.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Does that mean fundamental changes are needed in polling methodology going forward?

lines.speaker: 전문가
lines.en: Yes, relying mainly on phone surveys clearly has limits. A mixed method combined with online panels is being discussed as an alternative.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: So should we conclude that the credibility of polling itself has collapsed because of this result?

lines.speaker: 전문가
lines.en: I wouldn't say credibility has collapsed—rather, I think it should be taken as an urgent warning sign to overhaul the methodology.

phone-c2y-labor-automation.title: A podcast call-in debates automation and job loss

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today's topic is automation's impact on jobs, and we have a labor economist joining us by phone.

lines.speaker: 경제학자
lines.en: Hello. To cut to the chase, the narrative that automation destroys jobs is, in a way, an overly simplified one.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: I'm curious what grounds you for that view. Hasn't workforce reduction been ongoing in manufacturing settings?

lines.speaker: 경제학자
lines.en: Reductions are real, but the job-creation effect from new occupations emerging simultaneously can't be ignored either. The friction occurs during the transition process, though.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, I work in manufacturing. Aren't those newly created jobs ultimately centered on highly educated workers? For people like us, it's a pie in the sky.

lines.speaker: 경제학자
lines.en: That's a painful but valid point. Without a supporting retraining system, that gap could only widen further. This is exactly why policy intervention is essential.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: So what policies do you think would be effective? Radical alternatives like universal basic income are being floated too.

lines.speaker: 경제학자
lines.en: Basic income is a contentious card to play. I think tailored vocational retraining and transition allowances during the industrial shift should come first instead.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: That sounds good in theory, but are there actual cases where such training programs worked? It feels like everyone just talks theory.

lines.speaker: 경제학자
lines.en: Some Nordic countries offer useful reference cases. Of course, it's hard to transplant them directly into our context, but there's a lot to learn in terms of direction.

phone-c2y-plagiarism-scandal.title: A journalist phone-interviews an academic about a plagiarism scandal

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling to ask about the academic society's position on the recent plagiarism allegations that have surfaced.

lines.speaker: 교수
lines.en: Yes, we're closely monitoring the situation as well. But since the verification committee hasn't reached a final conclusion, I need to be cautious about what I say.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Some media outlets are already reporting it as if the plagiarism were clear-cut. What's your view on that?

lines.speaker: 교수
lines.en: I think that's a hasty judgment. Determining plagiarism based solely on a similarity check result disregards proper academic procedure.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Then what exactly are the committee's evaluation criteria? What factors besides similarity are being considered?

lines.speaker: 교수
lines.en: We comprehensively review citation practices, contribution levels among authors, and the chronological relationship with prior research. It's not a matter to be concluded through simple comparison.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: If it's ultimately determined to be plagiarism, how will the society proceed with follow-up measures?

lines.speaker: 교수
lines.en: Retraction of the paper, of course, and even restrictions on the researcher's future submissions could be considered. That said, an opportunity to respond will absolutely be guaranteed beforehand.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Understood. May I request another interview once the final conclusion is out?

lines.speaker: 교수
lines.en: Yes, I'll respond in good faith as soon as the outcome is finalized.

phone-c2y-gentrification.title: A call-in show debates gentrification in an old neighborhood

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we're on the phone with an urban sociologist to discuss gentrification surrounding the redevelopment of the old downtown.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: Hello. This area has shown a textbook pattern over the past few years, with soaring rents pushing out longtime merchants.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, I've run a shop in that neighborhood for 15 years. Framing redevelopment as entirely bad seems a bit one-sided to me.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: I'm not denying redevelopment itself. The problem is that the structure concentrates development gains in outside capital rather than existing residents.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Then what's the alternative? Leaving it run-down forever isn't better for residents either, is it?

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: That's a fair point. That's why I'm arguing that buffer measures—like commercial rent caps or resettlement support for original residents—need to accompany the process.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Are there actual cases where such systems have been introduced? I'm curious whether this is just plausible in theory.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: Some local governments are attempting it through voluntary coexistence agreements, but the reality is that debate over their effectiveness persists because they lack enforceability.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: So in the end, without legal enforcement, it all amounts to empty slogans. It's a bitter point, but I can relate.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: Right, which is why discussions have recently reignited on establishing enforceable measures at least at the municipal ordinance level.

phone-c2y-ai-copyright.title: A radio debate on AI-generated art and copyright

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we'll discuss copyright issues surrounding AI-generated works, in a phone conversation with a copyright law attorney.

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: Hello. Under current law, the principle is that works created solely by AI are not recognized as copyrightable works.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, but what about cases where a user meticulously designs the prompt to create it? Do you also consider that not a genuine creative work?

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: That's a recent point of contention. There's also a view that if creative contribution through prompt design is recognized, there could be room for partial protection.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Then what controversies exist regarding the use of existing artists' works as training data?

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: This is an even hotter issue—there are multiple ongoing lawsuits arguing that using copyrighted works for training without consent itself constitutes infringement.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: So isn't it hard for artists to even know whether their work was used for training? The burden of proof seems terribly unfair.

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: That's an accurate point. That's why recent legislative discussions are pushing to require companies to disclose the sources of their training data.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: In the end, one can't shake the impression that law and institutions are failing to keep pace with the speed of technological development.

lines.speaker: 변호사
lines.en: I agree. That said, rather than simply tightening regulation, I think the key lies in finding a balance where creators and technological progress can coexist.

phone-c2y-corporate-scandal.title: A reporter phone-interviews a spokesperson during a corporate scandal

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling to hear the company's official position on the workplace abuse allegations reported this morning.

lines.speaker: 홍보팀
lines.en: Yes, first I apologize for the concern caused by that report. However, since the facts are currently under internal investigation, it's difficult to state anything definitively.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: According to the informant, an executive used abusive language toward employees and gave unfair work directives—can you at least confirm whether that's true?

lines.speaker: 홍보팀
lines.en: I ask for your understanding that we can't confirm the specific facts until the investigation results are out.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Then if this matter turns out to be true, is there a plan for action against that executive?

lines.speaker: 홍보팀
lines.en: Depending on the investigation results, we plan to take strict action through the personnel committee. There will be no exceptions regardless of position.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: There's testimony that employees raised this issue multiple times before, only to be dismissed. How would you explain that?

lines.speaker: 홍보팀
lines.en: That aspect is also included in the scope of the investigation, and we're jointly examining whether there were shortcomings in the system.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Understood. When are the investigation results and follow-up measures expected to be made public?

lines.speaker: 홍보팀
lines.en: We'll compile the results and make an official announcement within two weeks at the latest. We'll do our best to restore trust.

phone-c2y-euthanasia-debate.title: A podcast phone panel debates assisted dying legislation

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we're connected by phone with a bioethicist to discuss the legislative debate over assisted dying. Since it's a sensitive topic, we'll handle it carefully.

lines.speaker: 윤리학자
lines.en: Hello. This debate ultimately sits at the point where the right to self-determination directly collides with the principle of life protection, so it's not something to be concluded easily.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, I've had the experience of caring for a family member with a terminal illness. I really question whether prolonging suffering against the person's own wishes is truly right.

lines.speaker: 윤리학자
lines.en: That's an experience I can fully empathize with. But if it's institutionalized, the potential for abuse—especially concerns about pressure on vulnerable groups—must also be discussed.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: In countries where this is already in effect, have those concerns actually materialized in real cases?

lines.speaker: 윤리학자
lines.en: In some countries, controversy has arisen as eligibility criteria gradually expanded. It started limited to terminal patients, but the scope broadened over time.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: So you're saying that introducing it without strict criteria and multi-layered verification procedures would be dangerous in itself?

lines.speaker: 윤리학자
lines.en: Exactly. My position is that while self-determination should be respected, safeguards ensuring that decision is truly autonomous must absolutely come first.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: So beyond the for-and-against divide, you're saying the sophistication of institutional design is the key issue.

lines.speaker: 윤리학자
lines.en: Yes, I believe social consensus and careful procedural design should take priority over hasty legislation.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: It's a difficult topic, but listening today helped me gain a more balanced perspective, I think. Thank you.

phone-c2y-whistleblowing-app.title: A podcast host interviews a regulator on gig-economy algorithm transparency

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we'll discuss the transparency controversy over delivery platforms' algorithmic dispatch methods, in a phone conversation with a Fair Trade Commission official.

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: Hello. Complaints from delivery drivers that the dispatch criteria are arbitrary have surged recently, so we've launched a fact-finding investigation on our end as well.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, I also work as a delivery driver. I have no idea why calls flood to some drivers while I have to wait for hours.

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: That's exactly the core issue. The platform is refusing to disclose the detailed algorithmic criteria, citing trade secrets.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Can that trade-secret argument actually hold up legally? This is directly tied to working conditions.

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: Our position is that even without full disclosure, there's at least an obligation to explain the key variables that affect dispatch.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: So is legislation actually being prepared to enforce that explanation obligation?

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: Yes, an amendment codifying the right to demand algorithmic explanations has been introduced in the National Assembly, and we've submitted our written opinion as well.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: It'll take time before the bill passes—is there anything drivers can do in the meantime?

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: For now, if you document specific cases of unreasonable dispatch and submit them to our complaint center, we can reflect them in the investigation as collective grievances.

phone-c2y-historic-district.title: A call-in panel debates preserving a historic district versus new development

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we're on the phone with an architectural historian to discuss preserving the old downtown, which still holds modern-era cultural heritage.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: Hello. The buildings in this area shouldn't be viewed as merely aging structures, but as precious historical records documenting the modernization process.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Hello, I'm a resident of that neighborhood. While everyone clings to these old buildings, who's responsible for the safety issues? They'd collapse in an earthquake.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: That's a valid concern. But rather than full demolition, remodeling combined with seismic reinforcement could achieve both safety and preservation at the same time.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: That approach would be quite costly—how do you think the funding should be secured?

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: Support in the form of matched national and local funds, combined with the use of cultural heritage funds for part of it, is a common approach seen in overseas cases as well.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Even granting that money is spent to preserve it, how do you solve the dying commercial district? Only tourists pass through while residents are actually leaving.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: That's an accurate point. Unless priority tenancy rights for local merchants or rent stabilization policies are designed alongside preservation, it'll amount to an empty shell.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: So in the end, the key isn't the binary of preservation versus development, but how to harmonize both values.

lines.speaker: 학자
lines.en: Yes, and residents' voices absolutely need to be reflected from the policy-design stage onward for the outcome to be sustainable.

phone-c1z-hotline-intake.title: A whistleblower hotline intake call about workplace safety

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Hello, this is the anonymous reporting intake center. Please tell me the details and I'll record them.

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: I found out that our site has been falsifying safety inspection results before reporting them to management.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Could you tell me specifically which items were falsified?

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: I've seen ventilation readings that were below standard being recorded as normal, multiple times.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: We'll also need to know since when this has been happening, and whether specific people were involved.

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: It's been at least six months, and I've also heard from a coworker that the site manager gave the instruction.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Your identity will be kept strictly confidential, and after intake a separate investigation team will go verify the site.

lines.speaker: 제보자
lines.en: What happens if I face retaliatory personnel action while the investigation is underway?

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Under whistleblower protection rules, such action is itself subject to separate sanctions, so please report it again immediately if it happens.

phone-c1z-book-deal.title: Negotiating a book deal with a literary agent

lines.speaker: 에이전트
lines.en: The publisher sent over a proposal, but the advance is set lower than what was originally discussed.

lines.speaker: 작가
lines.en: How much of a difference is it? I thought they'd at least match the level of the last contract.

lines.speaker: 에이전트
lines.en: It's about 20 percent lower. In exchange, they've attached a condition to raise the royalty rate slightly.

lines.speaker: 작가
lines.en: That might be better in the long run. But what's the first-print run set at?

lines.speaker: 에이전트
lines.en: It starts at five thousand copies, but I think we can negotiate that further based on market conditions.

lines.speaker: 작가
lines.en: Then push for the original advance level, and if that fails, at least secure a bigger increase in the royalty rate.

lines.speaker: 에이전트
lines.en: Understood. I'll also propose separating e-book and audiobook rights into a separate contract.

lines.speaker: 작가
lines.en: Good. I remember losing out on that in a previous contract, so please pay close attention to it this time.

lines.speaker: 에이전트
lines.en: Sure, I'll share the revised proposal as soon as I receive it.

phone-c1z-crisis-line.title: A crisis-line volunteer handling a difficult call calmly

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: This is the 24-hour helpline. It sounds like you're going through a lot right now—please take your time and tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: It's just... nothing feels like it means anything anymore. I haven't been able to sleep for days.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: How long have you been feeling this way? Was there something specific that triggered it?

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: It's been like this ever since I lost my job a month ago. I can't even bring myself to tell my family.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: That must have been hard to carry alone. Right now, are you having thoughts of hurting yourself?

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: Sometimes those thoughts come up, but I haven't actually done anything.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: Thank you for being honest with me. Is there someone with you right now, or are you alone?

lines.speaker: 내담자
lines.en: I'm alone. But now that I've said this out loud, I feel a little like I can breathe again.

lines.speaker: 상담원
lines.en: I'm glad to hear that. I'll connect you to a counseling center tomorrow morning—shall we keep talking a bit more tonight?

phone-c1z-old-friends.title: Two old friends reconnecting after a falling-out

lines.speaker: 지훈
lines.en: Hello... it's me, Ji-hoon. It's been a while—I went back and forth for a long time on whether to call.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.en: Wow, it really has been a while. Honestly, I tried to reach out a few times too and stopped.

lines.speaker: 지훈
lines.en: What I said back then wasn't what I really meant—I think I said it too harshly out of anger. It's been weighing on me ever since.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.en: I think I was also being a bit too sensitive that day. But honestly, what hurt more was the silence afterward.

lines.speaker: 지훈
lines.en: You're right, that was the bigger mistake—I let my pride get in the way and couldn't reach out first.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.en: Still, I'm grateful you called like this. I thought about you a lot during that time too.

lines.speaker: 지훈
lines.en: If you're free next week, let's meet up and talk in person. There's so much catching up to do.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.en: Sounds good, I actually have something to do around there anyway. I'll look for a place.

phone-c1z-mediator-spouse.title: A divorce mediator on a preliminary call with one spouse

lines.speaker: 조정관
lines.en: Hello, I'm the mediator handling this proceeding. I'm calling today to walk you through how the whole process will go.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: Sure. Honestly I don't think this needs to go to trial, but I don't know the other side's position yet.

lines.speaker: 조정관
lines.en: Mediation is a non-binding process meant to help both sides find common ground. That said, property division and custody will likely be the two key issues.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: The custody part worries me the most. I don't want to move away from where we live now because of the kids' school.

lines.speaker: 조정관
lines.en: That will be addressed at the first joint session with the other party. It would help if you sent me your desired terms organized beforehand.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: There's not really much to fight over on the property side, but I'm worried things will get complicated if emotions run high.

lines.speaker: 조정관
lines.en: We've prepared separate individual sessions to prepare for that kind of situation, so you don't need to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 의뢰인
lines.en: Understood. I'll organize my terms and send them by email before the first session.

lines.speaker: 조정관
lines.en: Great, I'll review it as soon as it arrives and follow up to set a date.

phone-c1z-escalated-complaint.title: A call center supervisor debriefing an escalated complaint

lines.speaker: 팀장
lines.en: I'm calling to find out how that customer case handed off to agent number three earlier ended up.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Yes, they were very upset because they were charged twice—I processed the refund and apologized.

lines.speaker: 팀장
lines.en: I heard the customer also brought up compensation—how did you handle that?

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Since a coupon was the most I could authorize, I told them additional compensation would need supervisor review.

lines.speaker: 팀장
lines.en: Good call. But I heard the customer kept raising their voice during the call—wasn't it hard to handle?

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Honestly it was a bit tough, but I tried to stay calm and follow the manual.

lines.speaker: 팀장
lines.en: You did well. I'll personally follow up with the customer directly to walk them through a compensation offer.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Okay, I've left the customer's contact info and the call log in the system.

lines.speaker: 팀장
lines.en: I'll check it. For cases like this, it's fine to escalate to me right away in the future.

phone-c1z-persuasion-call.title: A political campaign volunteer making a persuasion call

lines.speaker: 자원봉사자
lines.en: Hello, I'm a volunteer reaching out to local voters. Do you have a moment to talk?

lines.speaker: 유권자
lines.en: Sure, if it's brief. But I'm not really interested in this election.

lines.speaker: 자원봉사자
lines.en: I understand. Is there a local issue that tends to concern you the most?

lines.speaker: 유권자
lines.en: Well, bus routes keep getting cut lately, which has been inconvenient.

lines.speaker: 자원봉사자
lines.en: Our candidate is actually campaigning on exactly that—expanding public transit. May I send you the relevant policy materials?

lines.speaker: 유권자
lines.en: Hmm, that's not bad. But I'm not sure the pledge would actually be kept.

lines.speaker: 자원봉사자
lines.en: I fully understand that concern. I'll also send you examples of policies actually implemented during the candidate's time as a city council member.

lines.speaker: 유권자
lines.en: Alright, I'll take a look at the materials and make up my mind.

lines.speaker: 자원봉사자
lines.en: Thank you. Would it be all right if I reached out once more before election day?

lines.speaker: 유권자
lines.en: Yes, that's fine.

phone-c1z-debt-collector.title: A debt collector call handled assertively by the debtor

lines.speaker: 추심원
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling regarding your outstanding credit card balance. If it's not resolved by the end of this month, it could affect your credit.

lines.speaker: 채무자
lines.en: Yes, I'm aware of the situation. But I find it uncomfortable that you're speaking in such a threatening tone.

lines.speaker: 추심원
lines.en: This isn't a threat, just informing you of the facts. If a full repayment is difficult, please tell me when it would be possible.

lines.speaker: 채무자
lines.en: My finances are tight right now, so I'd like to pay in installments—is that negotiable?

lines.speaker: 추심원
lines.en: It's possible, but you'd need to pay at least 300,000 won a month for it to be approved.

lines.speaker: 채무자
lines.en: 200,000 won is the most I can manage given my current situation. I'd like a written agreement on these terms.

lines.speaker: 추심원
lines.en: I'll check, but under our policy that adjustment may be difficult.

lines.speaker: 채무자
lines.en: Then I'd like to speak with your supervisor. And I'll let you know I'm recording today's call.

lines.speaker: 추심원
lines.en: Understood. I'll transfer you to a supervisor and send the terms in writing again.

phone-c1z-parking-ticket.title: Calling to contest a parking ticket with a bureaucratic office

lines.speaker: 민원인
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling regarding an objection to the parking violation fine issued last week.

lines.speaker: 담당자
lines.en: Sure, could you give me the case number? I'll check it along with the photo evidence.

lines.speaker: 민원인
lines.en: It's 2384. Actually the sign there was hidden behind tree branches and wasn't visible—I took a photo of it.

lines.speaker: 담당자
lines.en: If you submit that photo along with the objection form, we'll conduct a site check and start a re-review.

lines.speaker: 민원인
lines.en: How long does the re-review usually take? I have circumstances that require this to be handled quickly.

lines.speaker: 담당자
lines.en: It usually takes about two weeks, but if it's urgent, submitting online first may shorten it a bit.

lines.speaker: 민원인
lines.en: Understood. But is payment of the fine deferred until the re-review result comes out?

lines.speaker: 담당자
lines.en: Yes, once the objection is filed, payment is deferred until you're notified of the result.

lines.speaker: 민원인
lines.en: That's a relief. I'll submit the documents online today.

phone-c2z-study-findings.title: A scientist explaining a study's findings to a science journalist

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Could I ask a few questions about the paper you just published? I'd love it explained in a way general readers can follow.

lines.speaker: 연구자
lines.en: Of course. The core finding is that we confirmed a specific gut microbe is involved in regulating chronic inflammatory responses.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Does that mean this could actually be applied to treating a specific disease?

lines.speaker: 연구자
lines.en: There's potential, but since we're still at the animal-model stage, it's too early to say anything definitive. Clinical application would take at least a few years.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Would it be fine to write something like the press release title, 'treatment breakthrough imminent'?

lines.speaker: 연구자
lines.en: I think that's a significant overstatement. It could mislead readers, so I'd prefer something like 'suggests a possibility.'

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: Understood. Then could you also clarify how this study differs from existing theories?

lines.speaker: 연구자
lines.en: Previous views treated inflammation as driven solely by immune cells, but we showed that microbial interaction needs to be included as well.

lines.speaker: 기자
lines.en: I'll be careful to calibrate the language when writing the article. I'll send you the quotes to confirm before publication.

lines.speaker: 연구자
lines.en: Thank you. Accurate communication matters most to me.

lines.speaker: 감정사
lines.en: I reviewed the appraisal of the piece again, and unfortunately my conclusion is that it's very likely a forgery.

lines.speaker: 소장자
lines.en: That can't be right. Another institution confirmed it as authentic last time.

lines.speaker: 감정사
lines.en: I reviewed that certificate too, but it lacked pigment composition analysis. We found synthetic pigments that don't match the claimed period.

lines.speaker: 소장자
lines.en: Which pigment specifically is the issue?

lines.speaker: 감정사
lines.en: Titanium white was detected, and since that pigment wasn't commercially available until the mid-20th century, it contradicts the claimed date of the work.

lines.speaker: 소장자
lines.en: So are you saying the earlier institution made a mistake? This has major implications for insurance and resale.

lines.speaker: 감정사
lines.en: Rather than being definitive, I'd say it comes down to a difference in analytical methods—we used atomic absorption spectroscopy as well.

lines.speaker: 소장자
lines.en: I'd like to request a re-appraisal from a third, independent institution—could you recommend one?

lines.speaker: 감정사
lines.en: Sure, I'll give you two internationally credible options. That said, the results are likely to be largely similar to ours.

lines.speaker: 소장자
lines.en: Understood. I'll proceed with the re-appraisal first.

phone-c2z-adoption-agency.title: A prospective parent discusses the adoption process with an agency counselor

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: How are the documents coming along since our last consultation? Today I'd like to go over the whole process in more detail.

lines.speaker: 신청자
lines.en: Yes, most of it is ready, but I'm curious how the home study is actually conducted.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: A social worker will visit twice to comprehensively assess your living environment, parenting plan, and support system.

lines.speaker: 신청자
lines.en: Could you let me know in advance if there's anything in the criteria that might be a sticking point?

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: You mentioned both partners work, so how concrete your childcare plan is will be an important factor they look at.

lines.speaker: 신청자
lines.en: We have grandparents nearby who plan to help in the early stages—should that be included in the documents too?

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Yes, including that as a concrete part of your support system will reflect positively in the evaluation.

lines.speaker: 신청자
lines.en: Then at what point does the actual matching with a child typically happen? I feel like I need to prepare myself emotionally.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Once the home study is approved, a matching candidate is usually presented within two to three months. Prospective-parent education runs alongside that period.

lines.speaker: 신청자
lines.en: Understood. I'd appreciate it if you could also send me the education schedule.

lines.speaker: 상담사
lines.en: Sure, I'll email you the full schedule early next week.

phone-c2z-archaeology-permit.title: An archaeologist negotiates excavation access with a landowner

lines.speaker: 고고학자
lines.en: I'm calling because during a surface survey on your property we found fragments believed to be artifacts.

lines.speaker: 토지주
lines.en: What? Wouldn't that create a problem for my development plans for the land?

lines.speaker: 고고학자
lines.en: A detailed excavation survey is indeed needed, but development isn't necessarily blocked entirely depending on the results—the scope could also be limited.

lines.speaker: 토지주
lines.en: Then how long would the survey take, and who bears the cost?

lines.speaker: 고고학자
lines.en: It varies by scale, but typically about two months, and the cost is partly covered by Cultural Heritage Administration funding and our research institute.

lines.speaker: 토지주
lines.en: From my perspective, the delay to development is the biggest loss—is there a separate compensation process?

lines.speaker: 고고학자
lines.en: Yes, you can apply for compensation for the delay period caused by the survey under the relevant regulations. We can also help with the paperwork.

lines.speaker: 토지주
lines.en: And if something truly significant turns out to be there, what happens then?

lines.speaker: 고고학자
lines.en: In that case, preservation would take priority and land expropriation or purchase negotiations could proceed, but fair compensation is the principle even then.

lines.speaker: 토지주
lines.en: Understood. Please go ahead with the detailed survey first, and prepare the compensation documents alongside it.

phone-c2z-esports-contract.title: A talent manager disputes a sponsorship clause with a brand rep

lines.speaker: 매니저
lines.en: I reviewed the sponsorship contract you sent, but the exclusivity clause is set far too broadly.

lines.speaker: 브랜드 담당자
lines.en: From our side, preventing exposure to competitors is the whole point. Which part do you see as an issue?

lines.speaker: 매니저
lines.en: It bundles not just gaming peripherals but beverages and apparel into the entire category, which excessively restricts the player's individual activities.

lines.speaker: 브랜드 담당자
lines.en: For us, brand image consistency matters, so we had no choice but to set it broadly.

lines.speaker: 매니저
lines.en: I understand, but I'd like it limited to at least directly competing categories only. Otherwise, it blocks all of the player's individual sponsorship opportunities.

lines.speaker: 브랜드 담당자
lines.en: We'll try to coordinate internally. In exchange, we'd like the required number of broadcast appearances in the exposure clause to remain as is.

lines.speaker: 매니저
lines.en: We don't have a major disagreement on that. But the penalty clause is set excessively high, so that also needs re-review.

lines.speaker: 브랜드 담당자
lines.en: The penalty is there to deter breach of contract, so we can't remove it entirely, but we can discuss the amount.

lines.speaker: 매니저
lines.en: Good. Please prioritize those two points—narrowing the exclusivity scope and adjusting the penalty—in the revised draft.

phone-c2z-museum-repatriation.title: A museum curator discusses repatriation of a contested artifact

lines.speaker: 정부 대표
lines.en: I'm calling to hear the museum's position on the artifact repatriation request our government made.

lines.speaker: 큐레이터
lines.en: Yes, our internal committee reviewed it. However, there was a view that additional documentation on the acquisition circumstances is needed.

lines.speaker: 정부 대표
lines.en: According to our records, the circumstances of illegal removal during the colonial period are clear—what additional documentation do you need?

lines.speaker: 큐레이터
lines.en: Of course we're aware of that context too. But to legally clarify the circumstances of possession, we need documentation proving original ownership.

lines.speaker: 정부 대표
lines.en: Shouldn't this be seen as a matter of moral and historical justice rather than legal ownership?

lines.speaker: 큐레이터
lines.en: Personally, I agree. But to persuade the board, a legal basis needs to back it up for an actual decision to be made.

lines.speaker: 정부 대표
lines.en: In that case, we'll send you the national archive materials and a report summarizing the circumstances at the time again.

lines.speaker: 큐레이터
lines.en: Thank you. Once we receive that, I'll formally put it on the agenda for the next board meeting.

lines.speaker: 정부 대표
lines.en: How much longer do you expect this to take? We're in a position where we also need to keep explaining the progress to the public.

lines.speaker: 큐레이터
lines.en: The next board meeting is in two months, so a conclusion is likely to come then. I'll keep sharing progress with you in the meantime.

phone-c2z-vaccine-hesitancy.title: A public health official addresses a caller's vaccine hesitancy on air

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Today we have a public health official with us to take listener questions about vaccines. First caller, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: I read online that the clinical trial period for this vaccine was too short—has its safety really been verified?

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: That's a very understandable concern. But phase-three trials were conducted with a typical scale of participants, and continuous safety monitoring has continued even after approval.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Then why are so many adverse-event cases being reported? Isn't it that they were covered up and only came out later?

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: It's not a cover-up—since the adverse-event reporting system itself operates transparently, reported cases become visible in the open. But you need to distinguish between cases where causality has been confirmed and those where it hasn't.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: That distinction is hard for ordinary people to make. That's exactly why it's hard to trust.

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: That's a fair point. That's why we're trying to explain the causality assessment results in detail through a public monthly report.

lines.speaker: 청취자
lines.en: Is that report written in a way someone like me could actually understand?

lines.speaker: 관계자
lines.en: We also provide a summary version for the general public, so I'd encourage you to take a look. We'll share the relevant link after the broadcast.

lines.speaker: 진행자
lines.en: Thank you for the great question. Let's move to the next caller.

phone-c2z-linguist-endangered.title: A linguist explains urgency to a foundation reviewing a documentation grant

lines.speaker: 재단 심사위원
lines.en: I reviewed your proposal for the endangered-language documentation project, and the budget has grown quite a bit compared to previous years.

lines.speaker: 언어학자
lines.en: Yes, this time the speaker population has declined so sharply in the region that we had no choice but to extend the fieldwork period.

lines.speaker: 재단 심사위원
lines.en: Specifically, how many speakers are left? We need grounds to judge the urgency.

lines.speaker: 언어학자
lines.en: Only three fluent speakers remain, all in their late eighties. One of them has recently had a significant decline in health.

lines.speaker: 재단 심사위원
lines.en: That's genuinely urgent. But why did you decide that audio recording alone wouldn't be enough?

lines.speaker: 언어학자
lines.en: For oral narratives and ritual language, gestures and context need to accompany them for the meaning to come through fully, so video documentation and community collaboration are essential.

lines.speaker: 재단 심사위원
lines.en: Then I suppose that's also why a significant portion of the budget is allocated to compensation for local community collaborators.

lines.speaker: 언어학자
lines.en: Exactly. It's not our work alone—the principle of this project is to make sure the community owns and can use the materials themselves.

lines.speaker: 재단 심사위원
lines.en: The rationale is quite convincing. But you'll need to resubmit an itemized breakdown of the budget increase for board approval to go through.

lines.speaker: 언어학자
lines.en: Understood, I'll put together the itemized breakdown and send it within this week.

phone-c2z-diplomat-hostage.title: A consular officer briefs an anxious family during a hostage negotiation

lines.speaker: 영사
lines.en: I'm calling because there's been progress since last night. That said, I want to be upfront that nothing is confirmed yet.

lines.speaker: 가족
lines.en: Yes, what kind of progress? I haven't slept a wink all night.

lines.speaker: 영사
lines.en: The local negotiation team succeeded in a third contact with the captors' side, and safety has been confirmed.

lines.speaker: 가족
lines.en: That's such a relief... so when do you expect the release to happen?

lines.speaker: 영사
lines.en: That part is still under negotiation, so I can't give a definite answer. Coordination with higher authorities is needed regarding the demands.

lines.speaker: 가족
lines.en: Would it help or hurt the negotiation if we made this public through the media?

lines.speaker: 영사
lines.en: At this stage, the negotiation team's judgment is that keeping it private is safer. We'd ask that you consult with us first before any media response.

lines.speaker: 가족
lines.en: Understood. But I'm worried because there are people who want to step in and negotiate a ransom directly.

lines.speaker: 영사
lines.en: We strongly advise against that. Unofficial contact could actually jeopardize the negotiation team's official channel.

lines.speaker: 가족
lines.en: Okay, we'll talk it over among the family and make sure to hold back on that.

lines.speaker: 영사
lines.en: Thank you. I'll give you regular updates twice a day, morning and afternoon, whenever there's progress.
